$comment: GENERATED by viewer/tools/gen_timeline_parity.mjs — do not hand-edit. Cross-language parity for the timeline scrub model: viewer/timeline_core.js (JS, the reference) and ios/Shared/TimelineScrub.swift (Swift) must both reproduce every value here. Regenerate and commit whenever a folding or layout rule changes.

greek_width.label: A very long label that should clamp at the maximum width for the column

scenarios.name: ordinary-day
scenarios.why: A normal day: a few clusters, an hour of quiet that folds, one busy bucket.

scenarios.name: gap-is-never-folded
scenarios.why: A declared blind spot anchors the layout: quiet may fold around it, never over it.

scenarios.name: overnight-heartbeats
scenarios.why: A quiet night still folds; the fold reports the heartbeats sealed inside it.

scenarios.name: tamper-and-system
scenarios.why: Reserved statuses win their cell outright, so trouble is never averaged away.

scenarios.name: coverage-window
scenarios.why: Leading and trailing quiet fold against the export window; uncovered hours stay blank.

scenarios.name: trailing-heartbeats
scenarios.why: The domain spans heartbeats recorded after the last anchor; only folding excludes them.

scenarios.name: jittered-outside-window
scenarios.why: A jittered event outside the receipt window widens the coverage track to the bucket grid, so no lit cell is ever drawn over a region the same strip calls uncovered.

scenarios.name: tie-breaking
scenarios.why: Ties must resolve identically in both languages: one bucket with two equally-common families, and a mixed set of bucket sizes with an equal count.

scenarios.name: wide-span-ruler
scenarios.why: A years-wide export must still produce a readable ruler, not one line per day.

scenarios.name: single-record
scenarios.why: One record must still produce a valid, non-degenerate layout.
